keyFindings.description: Security[secret]: the new reconnect WARN logs `strings.Join(urls, ",")` verbatim. config.Load (internal/config/config.go:36-39) only trims NATS_URLS and LocalNATSURL (internal/bus/reach.go:57-72) accepts userinfo, while nats.go v1.50.0 connectProto (nats.go:2807-2817) authenticates with URL userinfo (a bare username is a token, user:password a password). So nats://user:pass@host or nats://token@host is written to the log on the first failed attempt, breaking R3's 'never the credential' and the comment at connect.go:93-94. Fix: one log-safe rendering that drops all userinfo (url.Redacted keeps a token-only username, so it is not enough), used here and by the ReconnectedCB line in the same callback (connect.go:112, nc.ConnectedUrl() returns URL.String() with userinfo, nats.go:2438); reach.go:48's refusal prints the raw URL the same way. Add a test case with a userinfo URL.

awaitDurableBound and durableProbe (durable.go:279) call ConsumerInfo with no nats.Context, so each request runs on the JetStream handle's 10 s MaxWait (internal/bus/nats.go:247, nats.go jsm.go:1781-1786) and monitorCtx cannot cut it: the 3 s rebind deadline stretches to about 13 s and shutdownListener's 10 s wait for the monitor (main.go:944-949) can run out, contrary to the comments at main.go:857-859 and durable.go:293-297. Pass nats.Context with a context derived from ctx and bounded by the remaining deadline.

The AfterFunc callback carries no identity of the stop that armed it and reportUnrepaired acts on whichever repairTimer is current. time.Timer.Stop does not wait for a callback already started, so a fired callback delayed past a successful Rewatch and a second stop reports the second stop as 'no repair within 1m0s' at once and consumes its timer. Capture the generation (or a per-arm token) and check it under mu.

stopNoticeBudget's comment calls 60 s 'six times the measured notice' from three ~10 s samples; the tester measured 18.81 s twice on the same server version. State the multiple as of its own sample (about 3x the worst observed).
